description: Re-render one already-finished clip with a new reframe layout and/or caption style (get valid caption_style values from katto_list_caption_styles). Free — does NOT use video quota. Each call starts a new render (not idempotent); the original clip is kept. Returns a rerender_id; poll katto_get_rerender for the new clip url.

caption_style.description: A caption style preset name. See katto_list_caption_styles for the labels.

clip_index.description: 0-based index of the clip to re-render.

name: katto_rerender_clip
